Last Day to Drop with a Tuition Refund or Change to Audit: March 31* Last Day to Withdraw Without Grade Penalty: April 22** Classes/Exams End: May 11 Last Day to Submit Grades: May 13 NOVA Online NOVA Online Sessions: View session dates and deadlines Important Dates for Financial Aid and Book Purchases Tuition payment deadline: If you register on or before January 6, your tuition payment is due by January 6. If you register on or after January 7, your payment is due the following day. Buy Books and Supplies with Financial Aid: Winter Session: December 3–December 22, 2025 Spring Session: January 6–March 31, 2026 Financial Aid Adjustments Begin: February 6, 2026 Classes added on or after this date for the current term will not increase student eligibility for financial aid grants. Aid may be reduced for students enrolled in less than 12 eligible credits. For more information, visit the financial aid policies page. Parking: Parking enforcement on Student and Hourly Parking Lots begins at 6:00 a.m. on February 6. Students are not required to display a permit while parked in a student and hourly parking lot after 3:45 p.m. on weekdays or anytime on weekends. Graduation Application Deadline: Last day to apply for graduation is March 1. Earlier application is highly recommended. Spring 2026 Breaks & Holidays Martin Luther King, Jr. Holiday: January 19, 2026Observed for students, faculty, and staff. College offices will be closed. Spring Break: March 16–22, 2026No classes will be held during this period.
